text:
jamie: starting a config-only deploy to nudge routing weights + tighten batching for low-latency tenants. quiet window 11:30-12:30 PST. plan: soft-pin new routing policy at 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~45m. please ack and watch 95p latency + error rate. will enable fallback routing if tail > 350ms. @sasha @nora

deploy-bot: Initiating deploy (config-only) 1729999999 by jamie. Targets: routing.policy.v3, batching.window_ms, timeout.ms. Canary: 10% for 20m.

sasha: ack. which dashboards to watch?

jamie: watch "infra/inference-latency" (95p, 99p), "routing/weight-shuffle" (per-tenant split), and "kvcache/evictions". metric thresholds: 95p increase >30ms or errors >0.5% -> rollback.

nora: add fallback rule to route to lighter-model if latency > 350ms for 2 consecutive mins? avoids user-visible spikes.

jamie: good call. adding fallback block now. snippet: ```yaml
routing_policy: 
  name: softpin-lowlatency-2026-03
  weight_map: {primary: 0.9, secondary-light: 0.1}
  fallback_threshold_ms: 350
  batching: 
    window_ms: 25  # reduced from 40
    max_batch_tokens: 1024
  timeouts: 
    request_ms: 30000
    stream_init_ms: 500
```

jamie: rollout commands: `rwbctl deploy config --policy softpin-lowlatency-2026-03 --canary 10` and `rwbctl observe canary --since 5m`.

deploy-bot: Canary at 10% started. Groups: prod-a, prod-b subset.

oncall-ops: watching. added log tail filter: `service:inference AND route:primary` to our incident view. will flag if error spike.

sasha: seeing a tiny bump in 95p (prod-b) +18ms at minute 12. error rate stable. keep monitoring?

jamie: keep canary running. if it stays <=30ms bump and errors <0.5% we proceed to 50%. i'm holding automatic increase to manual.

deploy-bot: Canary healthy at 10% for 20m, progressing to 50% as requested by jamie.

sasha: after increase to 50%, 95p sits +35ms on route X, but error rate up to 0.6% in a tiny subset. not uniform.

nora: recommend throttle back to 30% and enable fallback for the subset showing errors. we can target tenants via weight map.

jamie: doing `rwbctl deploy config --policy softpin-lowlatency-2026-03 --set canary=30 --target prod-b-subset`. enabling fallback override for prod-b-subset.

deploy-bot: Update applied. Canary now 30% (targeted) and fallback override enabled for prod-b-subset.

oncall-ops: confirmed fallback engaged for ~14 hosts. error-rate dropped to 0.25% and 95p latency back to +18ms.

jamie: sounds good. hold at 30% for 30m then promote to 100% if stable. note for release notes: config-only change, reduced batching.window_ms from 40->25 for low-latency policy, added fallback route to lighter-model, and soft-pin staging.

sasha: adding note to changelog draft and QA playbook. tagging docs for a short blurb.

deploy-bot: Canary window complete. No rollback triggered. Finalizing rollout to 100% over 15m.

nora: quick reminder — we should pin model versions for the fallback target to avoid silent shifts. can you add `model_pin: v1.3.2-light` to the policy?

jamie: done. updated policy with model pins.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete. Config-only deploy finished without automated rollback.

jamie: thanks team. action items: 1) docs blurb (sasha) 2) monitor 6h for regression alerts (oncall-ops) 3) add perf test to nightly suite for routing.policy.v3 (nora). closing thread. :white_check_mark:
